factor_derivation.evidence_completeness: sum of five booleans: component census, consumer/route census, candidate AS-IS contract, behavior contract, runtime observation or terminal probe
factor_derivation.semantic_clarity: category map ready=5, product=4, implementation=3, insufficient=2, experiment=1

algorithm.first_wave_rule: take the top 2–4 sorted ready_for_contract_decision families whose evidence_completeness is at least 4; no experiment winner and no rail promotion

hard_gate_predicates.ready_for_contract_decision: all four hard-gate ref arrays empty
